source_refs.note: Exercise 11.1, Question 3: book page 290 (Q1-Q8). The book prints no answers for Unit 11; every answer here is ours.

blocks.prompt: 3. Write a vector function for a car moving along a parabolic path.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi construction ka open sawal hai: car ka raasta parabola hai, jise hum \(y = kx^2\) maan lete hain.
Pehle hum tay karte hain ke \(x\) waqt ke saath kaise badalta hai (steady speed \(c\)); phir raasta khud \(y\) tay kar deta hai.
Rule: car sarak par hi rahe, yani har waqt \(y = kx^2\) poora ho.
Plan: components, vector form, domain; aakhir mein \(t\) khatam kar ke check karenge ke parabola hi wapas milta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: ek car parabolic (parabola jaise) raaste par chal rahi hai.
Maloom karna: us ki position ke liye vector function \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
Tareeqa: 11.1.3 ke teen steps. Sarak ko parabola \(y = kx^2\) (\(k \ne 0\)) maan lein jis ka vertex (choti) \(O\) par hai; \(t = 0\) par car \(O\) par hai aur us ka \(x\)-coordinate steady \(c\) m/s se barhta hai.

Step-1: Components maloom karein
\[x(t) = ct\]
\[y(t) = k(ct)^2 = kc^2t^2\]
Kyun: \(x\) barabar raftaar se barhta hai, is liye faasla \(=\) speed \(\times\) waqt, yani \(ct\). Car sarak se neeche nahin utarti, is liye us ka \(y\) hamesha \(y = kx^2\) poora karega; bas \(x\) ki jagah \(ct\) rakh diya.
Dhyan dein: \((ct)^2 = c^2t^2\); square poore bracket ka hota hai, sirf \(t\) ka nahin.
Yani raasta (sarak) aur raftaar mil kar position tay karte hain.

Step-2: Vector form mein jorein
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = ct\,\hat{i} + kc^2t^2\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(x\)-component \(\hat{i}\) ke saath aur \(y\)-component \(\hat{j}\) ke saath. Ab ek hi function car ki poori position batata hai.

Step-3: Domain batayein
\[t \ge 0\]
(jab tak car sarak ke mure hue hisse par hai)
Kyun: \(t\) shuru se naapa gaya waqt hai. Dono components polynomials hain jo har real \(t\) par defined hain, is liye sirf waqt wali pabandi hai.
Asal zindagi mein sarak ka mura hua hissa kahin khatam hota hai; isi liye misaal mein hum ne \(0 \le t \le 4\) liya.

Ek khaas misaal: sarak \(y = \frac{x^2}{10}\), \(c = 5\) m/s
\[x = 5t,\quad y = \dfrac{(5t)^2}{10} = 2.5t^2\]
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 5t\,\hat{i} + 2.5t^2\,\hat{j}\]
\(0 \le t \le 4\) ke liye: \(t = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4\) par points \((0, 0), (5, 2.5), (10, 10), (15, 22.5), (20, 40)\).
Kyun: yahan \(k = \frac{1}{10}\), is liye \(kc^2 = \frac{25}{10} = 2.5\). Points ko jor kar dekhein to parabola ka aadha hissa banta hai (figure). Har second \(x\) to 5 hi barhta hai magar \(y\) tez tez barhta hai: yahi parabola ki pehchan hai.

Tasdeeq: \(t\) khatam karein
\[t = \dfrac{x}{5}\]
\[y = 2.5\left(\dfrac{x}{5}\right)^2 = \dfrac{x^2}{10} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t\) hatane par sarak ki equation wapas mil gayi, yani har position parabola par hai. Sab se saada aisa function \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + t^2\,\hat{j}\) hai, jo kitab ki Figure 11.1 mein bana hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = ct\,\hat{i} + kc^2t^2\,\hat{j},\ t \ge 0\), raasta \(y = kx^2\); misaal: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5t\,\hat{i} + 2.5t^2\,\hat{j}\) (raasta \(y = \frac{x^2}{10}\)).

answer_figure.alt: Parabola y = x squared over 10 from the origin to (20, 40), traced by r(t) = 5t i + 2.5t squared j. Marked points: t = 0 at (0, 0), t = 1 at (5, 2.5), t = 2 at (10, 10), t = 3 at (15, 22.5), t = 4 at (20, 40). Arrows show the direction of motion.
answer_figure.caption: Path of the car r(t) = 5t i + 2.5t² j, 0 ≤ t ≤ 4, on the parabola y = x²/10 (our drawing)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (balke poore Unit 11 ke nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain. Yeh sawal "open" hai: is ke bahut se sahi jawab ho sakte hain. Hamara jawab ek model jawab hai jo kitab ke teen steps (11.1.3) se banaya gaya hai; agar aap ka function motion ko sahi tarah describe karta hai to woh bhi bilkul sahi hai.
